title: Some butter always sticks on the inside
text: Some butter always sticks on the inside. I purchased these at Home Goods a while back because I was attracted to the beautiful colors and the idea that I would not get my hands dirty when buttering corn.  They are functional, but I'm not as enthralled with them as the other reviewers are. The reason is that some butter always gets left behind in the spreader. Also, it is a pain to clean the butter out of the edges. I'm actually disappointed with these and had I known this, I would not have purchased them.  The only plus to me is that they are colorful; however, I still wind up with butter on my hands during the washing process.
